owner: Codex active project session; user retains large-model execution handoff
authorization: User requested a history-preserving revert of five v22 commits and execution of the five research tasks.
data_role: All twelve recovered filings and every earlier inspected project source remain development material.

adaptation.development: Fix diagnosed problems immediately in a new named version; retain prior inputs, predictions, failures, exclusions and receipts. Recompute development outcomes under the new version and label them post-development.
adaptation.confirmatory: No method, threshold, prompt, cohort, primary endpoint, budget or reference changes after predictions begin. A fix requires a new version and fresh independent confirmation; the original failure remains reported.
adaptation.selection: No searching through questions, issuers or baselines until a method wins. Freeze bounded source probes and record every selected item and exclusion.

hard_stops: No natural text/table retrieval track without a source-grounded question unresolved by a competent typed and structural baseline.
No retrieval comparison if the corresponding complete-evidence reader gate fails.
No automatic claim of complete candidate coverage from beam rank, score, saturation, candidate count or finite optimization.
No confirmatory prediction before independent references, issuer exclusions and analysis are frozen.
large_model_execution: Deferred to a concrete local handoff after source/data/configuration readiness; zero large-model calls authorized or represented by this contract alone.
publication_claim: Preparation and software/source checks do not establish novelty, empirical improvement or ACL readiness.
